Text.Text: The engine is down and the surviving drills are isolated. We can rebuild them with proper safeguards. You kept control when the machine could not. I will finish your Saber Storm instruction.
I can only take someone who has mastered the lightsaber discipline. Reach rank 50 before we discuss the work below.

Drop the rear shoulder. There. Now look at this scorched training slate. The storm network has locked the instructors out and raised its droids to lethal output. Disable 6 Storm Drill Droid units in the outer ring of the Dantooine Jedi Enclave Trial Halls. Recover the Saber Storm Enclave Trial Slate.
Take the Dantooine Jedi Enclave Trial Halls Key. Disable 6 Storm Drill Droid units in the outer ring of the Dantooine Jedi Enclave Trial Halls. Recover the Saber Storm Enclave Trial Slate.
Saber Storm keeps an attack moving without losing your footing. A droid can copy the cuts; knowing when to stop is your part.

The key opens the sealed entrance to the Dantooine Jedi Enclave Trial Halls. Start in the outer ring. I am keeping the public training rooms shut and the shutdown line isolated. If I abandon that console, the faulty routines can reach the occupied wing.
They are training machines running recordings I supplied. No students remain inside. The chassis have stopped accepting a yield or a remote shutdown.
Disable 6 Storm Drill Droid units in the outer ring of the Dantooine Jedi Enclave Trial Halls. Recover the Saber Storm Enclave Trial Slate.
You have the Saber Storm Enclave Trial Slate. Let me see it.
The slate records the shutdown failures. The next controller is deeper inside.

The outer units are down. Their timing controller still drives the next set of machines. Disable 5 Storm Duelist Droid units in the middle ring of the Dantooine Jedi Enclave Trial Halls. Recover the Saber Storm Kyber Focus Shard.
Disable 5 Storm Duelist Droid units in the middle ring of the Dantooine Jedi Enclave Trial Halls. Recover the Saber Storm Kyber Focus Shard.
The next units react to each other. Bait one attack, move out of its partner's line, then close before their routines synchronize again.
The Saber Storm Kyber Focus Shard belongs to the training array. It helps coordinate the practice emitters; return it so the technicians can trace the fault.
Continue beyond the outer ring into the middle ring. Keep a way back to the stairs.
Disable 5 Storm Duelist Droid units in the middle ring of the Dantooine Jedi Enclave Trial Halls. Recover the Saber Storm Kyber Focus Shard.
You brought the Saber Storm Kyber Focus Shard. Hand it over and we can finish this part.
The focus shard is secure. We can now work on the sealed gate.

The next gate has an independent controller. The remote shutdown still cannot reach it. Disable 1 Storm Gatekeeper Droid in the third trial door of the Dantooine Jedi Enclave Trial Halls. Recover the Saber Storm Fractured Trial Sigil. Bring at least two allies.
Disable 1 Storm Gatekeeper Droid in the third trial door of the Dantooine Jedi Enclave Trial Halls. Recover the Saber Storm Fractured Trial Sigil. Bring at least two allies.
The Storm Gatekeeper Droid is a reinforced gate-control construct. Its shutdown channel is broken, so the chassis must be disabled directly.
The Saber Storm Fractured Trial Sigil is the damaged authorization plate from that gate. Recover it so we can restore the lock without reactivating its defender.
Three fighters can divide its attention and cover a retreat. This is damaged equipment operating at lethal output; do not treat it as a practice duel.
Disable 1 Storm Gatekeeper Droid in the third trial door of the Dantooine Jedi Enclave Trial Halls. Recover the Saber Storm Fractured Trial Sigil. Bring at least two allies.
You brought the Saber Storm Fractured Trial Sigil. Hand it over and we can finish this part.
The gate is clear. The sigil will let us identify the remaining control seals.

The gate is open, but four linked constructs still protect the control chamber. Disable 4 Storm Examiner Droid units in the high ring of the Dantooine Jedi Enclave Trial Halls. Recover the Saber Storm Council Trial Chit.
Disable 4 Storm Examiner Droid units in the high ring of the Dantooine Jedi Enclave Trial Halls. Recover the Saber Storm Council Trial Chit.
The Saber Storm Council Trial Chit authorizes service access to the training network. Recover it so the instructors can restore service access.
The four constructs share targeting data. Break their formation before they can concentrate every attack on one of you.
Their routines were built from recorded exercises. The engineers can rebuild the machinery once you have made the wing safe.
Disable 4 Storm Examiner Droid units in the high ring of the Dantooine Jedi Enclave Trial Halls. Recover the Saber Storm Council Trial Chit.
You brought the Saber Storm Council Trial Chit. Hand it over and we can finish this part.
The token is secure. There is one final chamber to clear.

Only the central training engine remains. Until it is disabled, it can restart the damaged routines. Disable 1 Tempest Training Engine in the deepest trial hall of the Dantooine Jedi Enclave Trial Halls. Bring at least two allies.
Disable 1 Tempest Training Engine in the deepest trial hall of the Dantooine Jedi Enclave Trial Halls. Bring at least two allies.
The Tempest Training Engine coordinates this branch of the training network. Its adaptive combat routines let it direct several attackers at once.
Stay close enough to help each other without offering it one easy line of attack. Trade the pressure between you and keep the escape route open.
The hall will stay sealed until the engineers replace the faulty controllers and test every shutdown. Nobody will be sent back into ordinary lessons while these faults remain.
Disable 1 Tempest Training Engine in the deepest trial hall of the Dantooine Jedi Enclave Trial Halls. Bring at least two allies.
The Tempest Training Engine is down. Tell me what happened.
The engine is down and the surviving drills are isolated. We can rebuild them with proper safeguards. You kept control when the machine could not. I will finish your Saber Storm instruction.
Go over the first assignment.
I will clear the outer chambers.
What does this discipline teach?
Where do I go, and why are you staying here?
Who or what will I be fighting?
I need to prepare first.
Here is the recovered slate.
Go over the next objective.
I will recover the focus shard.
What should I know before going deeper?
What is the focus shard?
Where is the next group?
I need more time.
Here is the focus shard.
Explain the gate assignment again.
I will bring two allies and clear the breach.
What guards the gate?
Why recover the broken sigil?
Why bring a group?
I will gather my companions first.
The gate is clear. Here is the sigil.
Go over the four targets again.
I will clear the control chamber.
What does the access token do?
How do they work together?
Can the machines be repaired?
I need to rest first.
Here is the recovered token.
Go over the final objective.
We will go in together.
What is waiting in the last chamber?
How should we fight it?
What happens after this?
My companions need to prepare.
The final target is down. We made it out.
